assumptions: Booked revenue is calculated as the sum of quantity * unit_price for order lines.
Q1 2026 is defined as 2026-01-01 through 2026-03-31 inclusive (implemented as < 2026-04-01).
Returns are not netted against booked revenue; only cancelled orders are excluded.
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price_cents),0) AS sum_cents, COUNT(*) AS line_count
FROM order_lines ol
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
WHERE o.customer_region = 'EMEA'
  AND o.status <> 'cancelled'
  AND o.order_date >= '2026-01-01'
  AND o.order_date < '2026-04-01';
